description: This Java class 'RestJsonConverter' provides utility methods to convert JSON data into internal data entries used within the Thingsboard platform, specifically for attributes and timeseries data. It includes parsing logic for different data types and handles JSON nodes to produce appropriate data entry objects.

classes.name: RestJsonConverter
classes.description: Utility class for converting JSON nodes to attribute and timeseries data entries used in Thingsboard.

methods.name: toAttributes
methods.description: Converts a list of JSON nodes representing attributes into a list of AttributeKvEntry objects.

methods.name: toTimeseries
methods.description: Converts a map of timeseries data (key to list of JSON nodes) into a list of TsKvEntry objects.

methods.name: parseValue
methods.description: Parses a JSON node value into a KvEntry object based on its type (boolean, number, textual, or JSON).

methods.name: parseNumericValue
methods.description: Parses a numeric JSON node into a LongDataEntry or DoubleDataEntry.
